units.rawText: When Hannah and I first decided to oppose the Sanctifiers, you were the one who reached a helping hand out to us—that was what I learned of the past from Hannah. However, that seemed as distant as someone else's story to me and I found it hard to understand.

units.rawText: However, I'm gradually coming to associate you with the Professor who saved us in the past, because you've helped us once again.
units.displayText: However, I'm gradually coming to associate you with the Professor who saved us in the past, because you've helped us once again.

spans.text: However, I'm gradually coming to associate you with the Professor who saved us in the past, because you've helped us once again.

units.rawText: I doubt we could have rebuilt Rossum as quickly as we did if it was only Hannah and I.
units.displayText: I doubt we could have rebuilt Rossum as quickly as we did if it was only Hannah and I.

spans.text: I doubt we could have rebuilt Rossum as quickly as we did if it was only Hannah and I.

units.rawText: We've only managed to pull ourselves together so soon because of your ceaseless efforts.
units.displayText: We've only managed to pull ourselves together so soon because of your ceaseless efforts.

spans.text: We've only managed to pull ourselves together so soon because of your ceaseless efforts.

units.rawText: From now on, I have a new objective beyond rebuilding Rossum, which is to repay you for all the help you've given us to the best of my ability... I can't believe I came up with an idea like that all on my own. Isn't that surprising?
